title: A Inheritance for the Parish
author: Dominic Okafor
blurb: Marguerite Sterling, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
